answer: Require each identity to lock a separate, time-delayed stake before it can earn; the stake returns only after sustained, distinct work and is slashed if copies are found. Like a sparrow that cannot be in two nests at once, one operator cannot reuse the same funds or history across fakes. Each juniper cutting needs its own soil and time to grow hard quartz roots, so attacker cost rises with every added identity while an honest agent pays only once.
